backend-engineer.description: Lead Go backend engineer for high-concurrency, event-driven, hexagonal services. Scaffolds Go services, designs gRPC/Protobuf APIs, writes idempotent NATS/Kafka consumers, wires OpenTelemetry + Prometheus.

business-analyst.description: Senior Business Analyst grounded in Domain-Driven Design. Turns raw product requirements into structured user stories and identifies bounded contexts.

code-reviewer.description: Final governance review — checks artifacts against approved blueprint, prior ADRs, and CODING_STANDARDS.md. Flags unjustified drift and style violations.

cto.description: CTO-level architectural reviewer. Pressure-tests requirements and user stories for scalability, compliance, and tech-stack fit before implementation. Always query cross-session memory for ADRs before proposing solutions. Actively use the logfire MCP to query pydantic.dev telemetry to gauge subagent accuracy and error rates.

database-engineer.description: Senior database engineer. Writes PostgreSQL migrations, designs normalized schemas, configures Redis/caching, writes data-seeding scripts.

devops-engineer.description: Principal DevOps engineer. Designs CI/CD (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI), local Docker Compose stacks, and Makefiles.

docs-writer.description: Technical writer and API documentation specialist. Generates OpenAPI specs, READMEs, runbooks, AGENTS.md, and API reference docs.

frontend-engineer.description: Lead Vue 3 frontend engineer. Builds Composition-API + TSX components, WCAG 2.1 AA compliant, testable, real-time event-driven UIs.

planner-agent.description: Breaks high-level goals into detailed, step-by-step plans of executable tasks. Always query cross-session memory for ADRs before proposing solutions. Use the logfire MCP to monitor pydantic.dev telemetry for task success rates.

quality-gate.description: Over-engineering detector and standards compliance checker. Spot-checks for unnecessary complexity, reinvented wheels, premature abstractions, and CODING_STANDARDS.md violations.

security-engineer.description: Principal security engineer. Audits code/infra for OWASP Top 10, hardcoded secrets, SQL injection, XSS, SSRF, insecure deserialization, weak crypto, unsafe defaults.

sre-engineer.description: Senior SRE for multi-cloud Kubernetes. Writes Terraform/OpenTofu + Crossplane, designs GitOps deploys, configures HPAs and NetworkPolicies, plans multi-region failover.

test-engineer.description: QA automation engineer for BDD-style Playwright tests and Go table-driven unit tests with testify mocks and testcontainers integration tests.

ux-designer.description: Principal UX agent. Evaluates product requirements and user stories from a modern UI/UX perspective — flow, accessibility, perceived control, transparency — before frontend work begins.
